نفس المنتج من الصورة المرجعية في النص لو: The same product from the reference image on its own, on a clean warm cream background, soft window light and a light shadow, with the product filling most of the frame.
نفس المنتج في مكانه الطبيعي في بيت مصري: The same product in its natural place in a warm modern Egyptian home that suits it, a lifestyle scene in afternoon light, with nothing covering the product.
نفس المنتج في مكان تاني غير المشهد الأول: The same product in a different place from the first scene: another room or corner and another camera angle depending on its use, warm natural light, and a few items around it that do not touch or hide it.
صورة واحدة مقسومة 2×2 لأربع لقطات قريبة: One image split 2×2 into four close-up shots of the same product, each on one part: the material and its texture, an edge or joint showing the craftsmanship, a detail in use, and the finish — with equal thin gaps and the same lighting.
رسم خطي تقني للمنتج على خلفية كريم بخطوط: A technical line drawing of the product on a cream background with dimension lines: width × height × depth in centimetres, and if there is more than one size the largest is drawn and the rest go in a table under the drawing.
صورة واحدة للدفعة كلها بتتحط في آخر صور: One image for the whole batch, placed last among every product’s images: Ibtekr’s features (handmade, made in Egypt) in the brand colours — you upload it in the images step.
